Kagetsu Tohya for Windows (English 0.5.2) [Fixed version without any existing savefiles!]
description:
#### A new version with correct soundtrack [here](https://sukebei.nyaa.si/view/3301601)!

The PC (Windows) version of Kagetsu Tohya. It is a fandisc for Tsukihime. It's ~~recommended~~ required that you complete every route in [Tsukihime](https://sukebei.nyaa.si/view/181368) and the short [Tsukihime Plus+Disc](https://nyaa.si/view/453758)  first before playing this.

The game has already been patched and is ready to go. Just extract the folder with a file archiver such as 7zip (https://www.7-zip.org/) and and launch the game with "Kagetsu Tohya.exe". 

The difference between this release and the other one here is that this one doesn't have any pre-existing savefiles in it. In other words it's a 100% fresh start and a complete experience for you. "Skip parts previously read" function works correctly and all the graphics which shouldn't be unlocked at the beginning aren't unlocked.
